description: Use Salesforce REST API resources under /services/data/v{version} beyond record CRUD on the registered org. Operations: resources (GET /), limits (GET /limits), recent (GET /recent; query limit), describe_global (GET /sobjects), sobject_info (GET /sobjects/{sobject}; basic information and recentItems), describe (GET /sobjects/{sobject}/describe; full field metadata, If-Modified-Since passes through headers), updated and deleted (GET /sobjects/{sobject}/updated or /deleted; query start and end as ISO 8601 date-times), get_by_external_id (GET /sobjects/{sobject}/{external_id_field}/{external_id}; optional fields), upsert_by_external_id (PATCH the same path; body fields; query updateOnly true updates and never creates), delete_by_external_id (DELETE the same path), relationship (GET /sobjects/{sobject}/{id}/{relationship}; optional fields), query (GET /query; q), query_all (GET /queryAll; q, includes deleted and archived records), query_more (GET the nextRecordsUrl given as next_records_url), explain (GET /query; explain is a SOQL query, report id or list view id), search (GET /search; q is SOSL) and parameterized_search (POST /parameterizedSearch; body q plus sobjects, fields, in, overallLimit and the other documented members). Salesforce permissions alone decide each operation, including upserts and deletes. Returns job_id/status queued.
embedding_description: Use Salesforce REST resources beyond basic record CRUD: org API limits, recently viewed items, object info and full describe, record ids updated or deleted in a time window, get, upsert or delete a record by external id, traverse a relationship, run SOQL or queryAll page by page, explain a query plan, and run SOSL or parameterized search.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued dispatch: job_id and status. Completion: family, operation, method, status (HTTP), selected headers, body (the version's resource map; limits with Max and Remaining per limit; recent items; objectDescribe and recentItems; describe metadata; updated ids with latestDateCovered or deletedRecords with earliestDateAvailable and latestDateCovered; a record or upsert SaveResult with id, created and success; a query page with totalSize, done, records and nextRecordsUrl; explain plans with cardinality, leadingOperationType, relativeCost and notes; searchRecords), correlation_id, error_code for a 4xx/5xx or unknown status, failures when a save reports success false, and pagination.next_records_url for query_more.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Offer pagination.next_records_url as the next query_more call; it is never followed automatically, and a query page is not the whole result until done is true. An upsert answers 201 when it created the record and 200 or 204 when it updated one. Upserts and deletes change the org; queued means only that the job was accepted.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Call Salesforce REST API resources with the registered user's permissions.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params is raised before any vendor call when the operation, sObject, external id field or relationship API name, record id, external id value (1-255 characters), next_records_url (must be a query or queryAll locator path), documented query parameters (q, explain, fields, limit, updateOnly as a boolean, start and end as ISO 8601 date-times with a zone) or a required body member (q for parameterized_search) does not match the vendor shape. Vendor HTTP errors are completion data with error_code: sf.malformed_query (MALFORMED_QUERY, INVALID_FIELD, INVALID_TYPE), sf.bad_request (400), sf.session_expired or sf.auth_failed (401), sf.permission_denied (403), sf.not_found (404), sf.conflict (300 or 409 when an external id matches several records), sf.precondition_failed (412 for If-Match or If-Unmodified-Since), sf.api_error otherwise.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read the status and body before retrying. An external id that matches several records must be made unique in Salesforce; an updated or deleted window older than the vendor's retention fails with an out-of-range error, so use earliestDateAvailable. A permission error means the registered user lacks the object or field permission in Salesforce.
